summary: Root enum deserialization incorrectly forwards to deserialize_any, presenting a TOML table as a map to an enum visitor and rejecting valid input such as [Plain]. The fix implements deserialize_enum, validates that the root table contains exactly one variant, and calls visit_enum. Reverse only this root dispatch correction. The fix-added test enum_unit::from_std_table in tests/enum_external_deserialize.rs exercises this behavior and requires the easy feature. This is a source-based plan; tests were not run.
expected_failure: invalid type: map, expected enum TheEnum
